user_objective: Find >500% annual profit OR an actually profitable BTC candidate. Do not assert a guaranteed return.
scope: NEW BTCUSDT spot long/cash research. No shorts, borrowed funds, perpetual contracts, funding payments or live orders. No claim that this is the original frequent BTC Pressure strategy.

data.source: Official public monthly archives with published SHA256 checksums

definitions.ema: Long when fast EMA > slow EMA and close > slow EMA. Otherwise cash.
definitions.sma: Long when SMA50 > SMA200 and close > SMA200.
definitions.channel: Enter on closed price exceeding prior lookback high, exit below prior shorter-lookback low. Keep state between events.
definitions.momentum: Long if close > its value 63 days earlier and > SMA200.
definitions.dip: In close>SMA200 regime, buy RSI2<10, exit RSI2>70 or after five daily bars, or loss of regime. This is a faster comparator, not tuned to results.
definitions.ensemble: PRIMARY FIXED strategy: daily majority vote of EMA10/50, channel55/20 and momentum63/SMA200; at least two positive -> long, otherwise cash.

primary: ensemble_1d; fixed before results, not selected on the evaluation period
challenger_selection: Only 2020-01-01 to 2024-01-01: rank positive net CAGR divided by max(10%, absolute max drawdown), require >=12 completed trades, no execution incompleteness. Break ties by ID. Select exactly one challenger before opening 2024 and later returns. 2024 is validation, never rerank after validation or final results.
history_status: History has been used by the wider research program, including August 2026. Every result is historical REUSED research, not pristine OOS or live forward. All ten later outcomes retained; any ex-post winner labeled exploratory.

execution.position: Buy fixed BTC quantity using at most allocation fraction of current cash when flat; sell all on exit; never average down or rebalance intraposition.
execution.participation_cap: 0.1% of preceding complete hourly BTC volume; reject entries above cap, not optimistic partial filling
execution.fees_paid_in: quote currency modeled; no BNB discount assumed

primary_risk: No leverage, at most 100% spot purchase. This is NOT the old 0.25% per-trade /7% permanent-loss setup. Slow trend exits are not a 10% drawdown guarantee; actual drawdowns must be reported prominently.
risk_comparators: 25% cash allocation at entry, unchanged signal
100% allocation with permanent 7% equity drawdown stop using previous closed-hour peak, no restart after halt
cost_stresses: double commission and slippage together, same signals but rerun sizing
same-fills double-commission arithmetic, not a new executable strategy
benchmark: Buy-and-hold BTC spot and cash with the same interval, initial capital and fee/slippage convention; 25% buy-and-hold comparator too. Profit alone is not alpha.
gaps: Do not synthesize candles. Retain missing-hour mask, reset multi-bar indicator history at gaps. Block new entries until complete support. Price/data gaps while exposed mark execution incompleteness; returns may be diagnostic but cannot count as a validated result. Whole incomplete aggregated bars invalid.
tests: known synthetic returns and cashflow reconciliation
untuned primary and pre-final challenger lock
annual500_evidence: Report actual calendar-year returns and >=365-day CAGR separately. A cumulative multiyear return >500% is NOT +500% per year. At most an observed historical simulation, never future certainty.
publication: Isolated research only; publish code, all outcomes, complete fills, equity series and CI evidence via PR to main. Existing research/runtime not modified. No secrets, purchases or live orders.
